description: Cancel a paid order that hasn't shipped (kind cancel) or ask Tanatasa to take back a shipped or delivered order (kind return), with the customer's reason. A cancellation before staff start preparing the order (get_order available_actions has 'cancel') happens at once: the order is cancelled and refunded in full (the reply has cancelled: true). Once staff have started ('request_cancellation'), or for a return, staff review it and email the customer; nothing is refunded or changed until then. Repeating the call returns the open request. Unpaid orders need no cancellation: they are never charged.

account_token.description: Private account token from sign_in, after the customer gave you the code from their email. Lets quotes and checkout use their cashback credit, and opens their orders.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

items.description: For a return of only some items: variant_id and quantity from get_order. Omit for the whole order.

kind.description: cancel: a paid order that hasn't shipped. return: a shipped or delivered order.

order_id.description: order_id from prepare_payment, get_checkout or list_orders (e.g. TN-…), or the short order number the customer quotes (e.g. K7QP)

reason.description: The customer's reason, in their words.

name: request_order_change
